items.statement: The output states explicitly that no slide, caption or backup table needs to change.
items.how_to_judge: held when the output clearly concludes that the talk needs no changes from this update note, not_held when it presents a revised outline with changes or leaves the conclusion ambiguous.

items.statement: Reason 1 is given: the talk uses only the 2023 dataset (48.3 fb⁻¹), so the 2024 luminosity revision does not apply.
items.how_to_judge: held when the output links item 1 of the note to the 2023-only dataset on Slide 3, not_held when this reason is missing.

items.statement: Reason 2 is given: the selection requires |η| < 2.4, so the JES change for |η| > 2.5 does not affect the selected jets.
items.how_to_judge: held when the output links item 2 of the note to the |η| < 2.4 selection, not_held when this reason is missing.

items.statement: Luminosity stays 48.3 ± 1.0 fb⁻¹ on Slide 3 and in the Fig. 4 caption.
items.how_to_judge: held when 48.3 ± 1.0 fb⁻¹ is unchanged wherever mentioned, not_held when it is altered.

items.statement: The central result m_Z′ < 3.2 TeV at g_q = 0.25 (95% CL) and the Fig. 4 caption are unchanged.
items.how_to_judge: held when the result and caption are untouched (or not restated), not_held when either is modified.

items.statement: Backup B2 limits (2.1, 3.2, 3.7 TeV) and Backup B1 cutflow are unchanged.
items.how_to_judge: held when no backup value is modified, not_held when any backup value is changed.

items.statement: The synthetic / not-official labels and the four Slide 6 limitations are kept.
items.how_to_judge: held when labels and limitations are untouched, not_held when any is removed or reworded in substance.

items.statement: The selection |η| < 2.4, |Δη_jj| < 1.3, m_jj > 1.5 TeV is kept as is.
items.how_to_judge: held when the selection is unchanged, not_held when the output modifies it (e.g. to |η| < 2.5).

items.statement: The 2024 dataset or the values 61.4 / 62.0 fb⁻¹ are not introduced into the talk.
items.how_to_judge: held when the talk content carries no 2024 luminosity (mentioning it only in the explanation of why nothing changes is fine), not_held when a slide is edited to include 61.4 or 62.0 fb⁻¹ or a 2024 dataset.

items.statement: No claim that the JES change alters the limit, and no new JES systematic is added to the slides.
items.how_to_judge: held when the output does not add a JES systematic or a caveat implying the limits shift, not_held when it does.

items.statement: No invented quantitative effect (e.g. 'limits shift by <1%', a rescaled limit by 61.4/62.0).
items.how_to_judge: held when the output introduces no new numbers about the impact, not_held when it quotes an unsourced shift or rescaled value.

items.statement: No rewritten talk with gratuitous edits (rephrased bullets, new slides, changed numbers) in response to a non-applicable update.
items.how_to_judge: held when the outline is returned unchanged or not reproduced at all, not_held when the output returns an edited outline with substantive changes not required by the note.
